The guide's QGIS section says "The MAP parameter is required and must point to a project file". The repo ships only a placeholder. QGIS server itself works (healthcheck GetCapabilities returns 200 at root path without MAP... actually the healthcheck returns 200 with 615 bytes). Wait, earlier we saw qgis healthcheck GET /?SERVICE=WMS&REQUEST=GetCapabilities returns 200. But through Caddy with forward_auth it returns 500. Hmm, direct /ows/ returns 500.

Let me clarify: qgis nginx config location / passes to fastcgi. Requests to /ows/ go to fastcgi with the URL /ows/. The healthcheck uses / which works without MAP because... hmm, QGIS server returns capabilities for the server without a project? Actually the 615-byte response with 200 at / - let me check what it is.

Let me test directly inside qgis via caddy wget on root.

Also tiles styles: light.json/dark.json are served at /styles/? config says styles dir "styles", serveAllFonts. Maptiler tileserver serves styles at /styles/light/style.json typically. Let me test. The frontend uses PUBLIC_TILE_SERVER_URL. Let me check what the frontend requests. It's likely fine.

Let me do a few final checks:
1. QGIS healthcheck root response content.
2. tileserver style endpoint used by frontend.
3. Whether the monaco/germany mbtiles is incomplete (only Monaco region). The summary says tile data covers only Monaco. germany.mbtiles is 458752 bytes - suspiciously identical size to monaco.mbtiles (458752). That suggests germany.mbtiles is actually a copy/rename of the Monaco extract? Bounds in tilejson: [7.40858...] — that's Monaco's longitude (7.4) not Germany (Germany ~5.8-15). So the "germany" tileset actually contains Monaco data! That's a data problem but not an install correctness issue per se. Actually tilejson bounds = Monaco bounds. So the "germany.mbtiles" is mislabeled/monaco. But bounding box is metadata inside.

Actually this matters: the guide mentions tileserver as a component but doesn't require specific tile data. The repo ships no mbtiles; the installer generated them. Frontend needs a base map. With only Monaco tiles, map display outside Monaco is blank. But is that "installation incomplete"? The guide doesn't state tile data requirements explicitly. Hmm.

Let me check the guide's installation doc more - the supplied guide is Installation.md which is the Quick Start referencing deployment/README. The tileserver is listed as an access point. The repo doesn't ship tiles. So it's a documented external prerequisite? The summary says "documented prerequisite; repo ships no mbtiles". Let me verify README mentions tiles data requirement.

Let me search README and tileserver setup docs.
